(Fatwa: 1135/1049=B) If you like you may name him Zuhair, Zubair, or Affan, Salman, Noman on the pattern of your name. Get Surah Fatiha written on a biscuit and feed him in the morning for forty days with Khameerah Marwareed Khas (Unani medicine) 3 masha. In-sha-Allah, all the problems will go away. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
